name: Inspired by Keinemusik
description: Berlin collective (&ME, Rampa, Adam Port, Reznik). Percussive afro and melodic house with lush melodies, chant-like or emotive vocals, long builds, extended back-to-back sets.
notes: Signature tracks sit at 119-122 BPM (Move 120 BPM Ab minor, Muye Black Coffee remix 120 BPM A minor). Prefer shakers, toms, tonal percussion, piano, uplifting vocals. Build slowly, place big vocals at peaks.
